opportunities.title: International Payroll Analyst
opportunities.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

Reddit is seeking an experienced, highly analytical International Payroll Analyst to own and scale our international payroll operations across LATAM, EMEA, and APAC regions. As a key individual contributor with deep cross-functional influence, you will combine data-driven execution, meticulous attention to detail, and international tax compliance to support a rapidly growing workforce. Reporting to the Sr. Global Payroll Manager, this role will help to drive major strategic initiatives—including Workday enhancements and global payroll vendor implementations—to build scalable, best-in-class operational processes. The role partners closely with Payroll Vendors and internal teams across People, Finance, Tax, Legal, Treasury, Equity, and Internal Audit to deliver accurate, timely, compliant, and employee-centered payroll outcomes.

What You’ll Do:

  • International Payroll Execution & Oversight: 
    • Manage, audit, and execute multi-country payroll delivery across 15+ international countries, including payroll inputs, validation, approvals, funding coordination, reconciliations, statutory filings, and post-payroll activities ensure high accuracy and strict adherence to strict regional pay schedules.
    • Lead the payroll calendar and operating cadence across countries, proactively managing dependencies, cutoffs, exceptions, and risks to ensure employees are paid accurately and on time.
    • Partner with local in-country payroll providers to maintain strict adherence to regional pay schedules and statutory processing windows.
  • Compliance & Equity Management: Oversee international equity compensation payroll processing (RSUs, Stock Options) and ensure full regulatory compliance across international tax jurisdictions, localized statutory benefits, and reporting requirements.
  • Systems & Scaling Initiatives: Act as functional lead for payroll technology projects, leveraging Workday to automate workflows, optimize system configurations, build custom reporting, and partner with the Sr. Global payroll Manager to implement upcoming enterprise Global Payroll solutions.
  • Cross-Functional & Vendor Management: Partner with Benefits, People Operations, Legal, and Finance; manage external vendor relationships and third-party tax fulfillment partners to ensure seamless funds reconciliation and local tax compliance.
  • Process Controls: Establish, document, and enforce global payroll policies, SOX controls, and standard operating procedures to streamline audit readiness (401k, Workers’ Comp, Financial Audits).
  • Strategic Growth Projects: Support special business initiatives, including M&A integrations, new country market entries, and business-critical cross-functional launches.

 

What We’re Looking For:

  • Experience: 5+ y

This role offers exposure to corporate strategy, commercial strategy, and business improvement initiatives in a purpose-driven organization. Your Responsibilities: Strategy support: Assist in developing and refining corporate and commercial strategies. Market & business analysis: Conduct market research, competitive analyses, and business case assessments. Commercial strategy projects: Support projects focused on areas such as sourcing, product development, partnerships, and market expansion. Data analysis: Assist in building financial models, analyzing commercial performance, and supporting data-driven insights. Workshops & stakeholder alignment: Help prepare materials for strategic discussions, workshops, and presentations for internal stakeholders and leadership. Business improvement initiatives: Support projects aimed at improving processes, frameworks, and internal ways of working. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality. Collaboration is fundamental to achieving our ambition. We nurture genuine relationships with global partners in our drive to make SAF the alternative to fossil jet fuel. Our in-house team of SAF experts have helped over 60 airlines and corporates reduce their climate impact using the Book & Claim mechanism; the most transparent and traceable way to support aviation sustainability with real emission reductions. Sustainability is woven into the fabric of our company. We maintain an independent Sustainability Board, which advises the company on feedstocks and provides strategic guidance on wide-ranging sustainability issues. SkyNRG operations are certified against the RSB EU RED, CORSIA, and Book & Claim standards. opportunities.description: About the Role Every month, hundreds of potential customers show interest in Trengo. They start a free trial, request a demo, or leave their contact details. But not everyone gets the personal follow-up they need to take the next step. That's where you come in. As our Marketing Development Representative (MDR) , you'll be the first personal point of contact for potential customers, helping them find the right way to get started with Trengo. You'll join our Growth Marketing team and work closely with Sales, sitting right at the intersection of marketing and sales. You'll turn the demand we generate into real business opportunities, whether that's booking a meeting with an Account Executive or helping someone become a paying customer through our self-serve journey. This is a hands-on junior role where you'll get to learn how a fast-moving AI SaaS company turns marketing efforts into revenue, with plenty of room to experiment, develop your skills, and make a measurable impact. It's an 8-month contract with the possibility of extension. About Trengo Welcome to the forefront of AI-driven communication. At Trengo, we’re redefining the industry by replacing repetitive work with meaningful conversations through our AI-powered customer engagement platform. We unify communication channels and leverage agentic AI to deliver proactive, human-like service, boosting efficiency for thousands of businesses worldwide. As a fast-moving Dutch scale-up, backed by a $36M Series A and an official WhatsApp Business Solutions Provider, we thrive on acceleration. Your expertise will drive growth: you’ll make a strategic impact, champion AI innovation, and help shape the product roadmap. You’ll do this alongside an international team guided by our Dynamic pace, Future-proof mindset, Ownership, and Open culture. What your role looks like: Turn inbound interest into opportunities Be the first personal point of contact for new inbound leads, reaching out through calls and personalised emails, ideally within the same working day. Follow up with qualified free-trial sign-ups, demo requests and prospects who have expressed interest but haven't booked a meeting. Re-engage prospects whose meetings weren't booked, were cancelled or resulted in a no-show, and help them take the next step. Connect qualified prospects with the right Account Executive, making sure they have the context needed for a productive conversation. Help prospects become self-serve customers Reach out to prospects who might not be the right fit for a sales conversation but could still benefit from Trengo. Understand what they're looking for, answer initial questions and guide them towards the right self-serve plan. Follow up with free-trial users to help them get started and encourage them to take the next step towards becoming customers. Improve how we engage with leads Experiment with different outreach messages, sequences and follow-up approaches to understand what converts best. Share insights with Marketing and Sales about common objections, lead quality and what prospects are looking for. Keep HubSpot accurate and up to date by logging interactions, tracking outcomes and maintaining clean lead data. How we'll measure success You'll have a direct impact on our growth, with clear results you can track: Speed of follow-up: Making sure inbound prospects receive timely, personal attention. Meetings generated: Booking qualified meetings that turn into conversations with our Account Executives. Self-serve conversions: Helping prospects progress from initial interest to becoming paying customers. Continuous improvement: Finding better ways to engage prospects and sharing insights that help our Marketing and Sales teams improve.
